description: CV to trigger utility: each of four inputs fires a gate whenever its voltage has moved more than a set amount since the last time it was read

params.text: Sets the gap between readings of the inputs, 16 samples at the bottom and 4400 at the top, about 100ms at 44.1kHz, so turning it up reads less often; it sets no pulse width, despite the tooltip name
Sets how big a move fires a gate, 0V to 2V of change between one reading and the next; at the bottom any change at all fires one

inputs.text: A voltage compared against its value at the previous reading, firing a gate at the matching output when it has moved more than the sensitivity allows

outputs.text: A 10V gate 10ms long, fired whenever the matching input has moved more than the sensitivity allows
